facts.fact: Minister of Communication Adji Ali Salatou said on 17 June 2026 that Niger is interconnected with several countries of the sub-region, namely Chad, Nigeria, Benin, Burkina Faso and Algeria; the text states interconnection, not that international internet traffic runs over each link, and Algeria's link was only being launched in October 2026.
facts.system: cross-border interconnections (Chad, Nigeria, Benin, Burkina Faso, Algeria)
